The deal, alongside regulatory approval for its next-generation satellite constellation, signals an escalation in SpaceX’s challenge to established wireless operators.

articles.title: Cheap Venezuelan crude could add up to Rs 12,600 crore to RIL’s EBITDA. What investors should know
articles.content: Reliance Industries could benefit from renewed access to discounted Venezuelan crude, which may boost refining margins at its Jamnagar complex. YES Securities estimates that every $1-a-barrel expansion in blended gross refining margins could generate around Rs 4,200 crore in annualised EBITDA. However, regulatory uncertainty, crude discounts and refinery utilisation will determine whether the opportunity translates into sustained earnings growth and stronger cash flows for investors.

articles.title: Banks seek RBI relief, clarity on India's latest rupee-defence measures: Report
articles.content: Banks have approached the Reserve Bank of India to request changes to the 20% cash deposit mandate. They propose that a flat charge replaces the deposit requirement for current-account hedging. This change could improve liquidity while ensuring cost transparency for businesses. Lenders also highlighted concerns over the $2 million threshold, which complicates hedge tracking. Clarity is needed regarding the deposit requirement for hedges related to interest payments on foreign loans.
